commitMessage:
Device card: clear 'Lokasi' and 'Bagikan' buttons; short notice for shared links

- The ambiguous 'Lainnya' (three dots) button is replaced by 'Lokasi'
  (menu 'Buka lokasi di': Google Maps, Apple Maps, Street View, the
  user's navigation app, then Buat Geofence and live video for JT808
  only) and a separate 'Bagikan' button.
- People who open a shared location link (temporary, read-only account)
  no longer get the full EULA: a short 'Lokasi yang Dibagikan' notice with
  four points and one checkbox, remembered in the browser.
- Docs updated.
